events.name: In The Christmas Mood with The Glenn Miller Orchestra
events.info: In the Christmas Mood with The Glenn Miller Orchestra. Please join us for this spectacular new holiday show as the legendary Glenn Miller Orchestra rolls out their timeless hits also putting a twist on our favorite songs of the holiday season. Home for the Holidays, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, White Christmas, Jingle Bells and I'll be Home for Christmas, are only some of the classics arranged and performed as only the Glenn Miller Orchestra can. We promise to keep you on your toes with all-time favourites like Chattanooga-Choo Choo, Moonlight Serenade, In the Mood and Pennsylvania 6-5000. In the Christmas Mood features over 18 musicians and singers performing the songs everyone remembers and the ones we all look forward to at the happiest time of the year. An evening filled with the warmth of the holidays and the legendary sound of the world's greatest orchestra makes the perfect gift for music lovers of all ages!

events.name: Cirque Musica Holiday Wonderland
events.info: CIRQUE MUSICA HOLIDAY WONDERLAND BRINGS THE MAGIC TO THE ABRAHAM CHAVEZ THEATRE ON DECEMBER 20, 2026! This holiday season, follow our heroes as they are transported into a dazzling winter wonderland where time seems to stand still. With each daring act, they grow younger, rediscovering joy, imagination, and spirit of the holidays they thought they had lost. This brand-new production blends world-class circus artistry with your favorite holiday music for a show unlike anything you've experienced. Breathtaking acrobatics, soaring aerial performances, and heart-pounding feats bring the season's most beloved melodies to life, delivering an unforgettable holiday experience for the whole family. Don't miss your chance to be part of the magic! Join us at the Abraham Chavez Theatre on December 20, 2026 for a night of wonder, excitement, and holiday cheer.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available during business hours at University Ticket Center On game day available at the Sun Bowl Box Offices 2 hours prior to game time. Picture ID and the credit card used to order the tickets will be required.

venues.parkingDetail: Limited parking available adjacent to the stadium.

generalInfo.generalRule: Venue has a Clear Bag Policy. No Cameras or Videocameras allowed. No Coolers, Drinks, or Food allowed to be brought into the stadium. Customers may bring binoculars. No Re-entry.
generalInfo.childRule: Children 2 years and older require a ticket.

events.pleaseNote: The venue has a clear bag policy. Adult content. See elpasolive.com for more info. Parking available in the Convention Center Parking Garage. It is recommended that Will Call tickets are picked up at least 1 hour before showtime. Reserved seating. Please note that the elevator does not go to the Balcony section.

accessibility.info: Accessible seating in the Plaza Theatre is available in a 1+1 seating configuration.

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 8 ticket limit for this event.

venues.name: The Plaza Theatre Performing Arts Center

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call may be picked up at the Venue, day of show, 3 hours prior to show time. Proper I.D. and confirmation number will be required

venues.parkingDetail: Parking will be at the Convention & Performing Arts Center. (subject to change) Parking is underground. You must take an elevator to get to the ground level.

generalInfo.generalRule: No cameras or recording devices are permitted. No food or drinks are allowed to be brought in. Please be aware of the numbering of seats in the Plaza Theatre: Orchestra level Right, seats are numbered in event numbers ex: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 Orchestra level Left, seats are numbered in odd numbers ex: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 Orchestra Center, seats are numbered in sequence 100 numbers ex: 101, 102, 103, 104, 105… Mezzanine & Balcony Right, seats are numbered in event numbers ex: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10… Mezzanine & Balcony Left, seats are numbered in odd numbers ex: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9… Mezzanine & Balcony Right Center, seats are numbered in even 100 numbers ex: 102, 104, 106, 108… Mezzanine & Balcony Left Center, seats are numbered in odd 100 numbers ex: 101, 103, 105, 107…
generalInfo.childRule: Children 2 years and over need a ticket -- this may vary
